title: Access the Front and Back Elements of a Deque

blocks.content: Access the Front and Back Elements of a Deque
Write a program to create and add elements to a deque.

items: Initialize a string deque named series with the elements Game of Thrones, The Last Kingdom, and Spartacus.
Print the front and back element of the deque.
